release_notes: Implemented Pulse Glass 141 (rp-mtnzjxi3-kkbrk) as an experimental Lean Custom WebGL2 renderer challenger for moor.city.island.
Pulse Glass renders on its own WebGL2 canvas behind moor.render/1 while preserving the legacy City renderer object for gameplay/input compatibility and rollback.
Renderer Pulls v0.2 adds a renderer-adapter registry so saved spec-only pulls can become runnable without changing app/gameplay code.
Pulse Glass exposes mandatory renderer telemetry, coverage/error penalties, and conditional deterministic RenderReplay support when the replay service is present.
No performance score is claimed by this release; use Renderer Pulls RUN on City Island to collect the first real score on your hardware.
Unsupported visual features remain explicit in v0.1: textures, shadows, sprites/LOD, and BatchedMesh are not yet fully rendered and reduce coverage/score rather than being hidden.
